content: The memory-curator implements a 5-step automated pipeline: 1) collect high-value info from session_search/letta/memory-engine, 2) refine/compress/deduplicate into durable facts, 3) write to MEMORY.md with capacity control, 4) optionally sync to letta memory blocks, 5) generate curation report. It is designed for cron-driven execution with fail-fast behavior on lock detection.
